column1: # Lamakan Desert: Mia is shaken by the Manticore, recognizes her anger, and asks the others to stay close.

column3: I wanted it dead after\nwhat it did. That frightens\nme more than I expected.{end_wait}
Mia... when it fell, you\nlooked relieved. Then you\nlooked almost afraid.{end_wait}
I know. For a moment, I\nonly wanted it to suffer.\nI don't want to be that.{end_wait}
I'm shaken, Isaac. Give me\na moment. I must remember\nthat fear isn't an excuse.{end_wait}
You don't have to face what\nhappened alone, Mia. We're\nhere, and we're listening.{end_wait}
